about: Descriptions that already made good HeroGen heroes; the Suggest an idea button shows these first.

ideas.text: A friendly chubby robot chef with a whisk hand and a white apron
An astronaut kid in a puffy white spacesuit with a fishbowl helmet and stickers
A moonlit mage with silver hair, layered midnight-blue robes, leafy shoulder cape, crescent pendant and embroidered stars. Full body, standing, plain background.
A punk rock grandma with a mohawk, leather jacket covered in pins and combat boots
A deep-sea diver in an old copper diving suit with a round helmet and lead boots
A cheerful beekeeper girl in a honey-yellow veil hat, a white padded suit with amber patches and green rubber boots
A tiny knitted-wool snow yeti with a red scarf, mitten paws and a blue bobble hat
A retired space knight robot with chipped teal armour plates, a round glowing visor and orange shoulder lights
A sunflower farmer grandpa with a straw hat, denim overalls, a yellow flower pinned to his chest and muddy boots
